_meta.title: A+B retained cruising record QA, 66–70
_meta.scope: Evidence and copy review, map location/access, recent reports vs online queries, dedup; no automatic site import
_meta.source_limit: Primary named directory forum + municipality official and archived eight-source checks; not authenticated exhaustive current browsing across all eight websites.

records.name: Weißeritz-Grünzug
records.identity: Dresden's municipality confirms a Weißeritz greenway of roughly four kilometres with connected public paths, green patches and cycleways through Plauen/Löbtau/Friedrichstadt toward centre. Current 51.04885,13.71446 is broad greenway location, not evidence that the old described stairway lies there.

activity.detail: Contributor reports seeing occasional men near stairs but no contact; not a sexual encounter.

records.access: Shared foot/cycle routes and parks, plus adjacent railway and residential land. Municipality planning maps confirm the greenway, not special adult-use access or source's exact stairs.
records.duplicates: No proven overlap with another Dresden park in active 92; do not conflate whole corridor with unknown steps.
issues: Location is broad named greenway as acceptable, but historical stairs need source map verification if precise walking directions desired.
2024 local policing reports are anonymous and should not be treated as verified current enforcement.

records.name: Rahmer See
records.identity: Rahmer See, Beckerfelder Straße/Rahm in Duisburg. General coordinates 51.3533632,6.7722413 represent a natural waterbody, not legal entry to private boating-club shores.

activity.detail: Poster says recently visited repeatedly with few/no men.

records.access: Duisburg official 22 May 2026 statement prohibits bathing in all publicly accessible city lakes other than designated lidos Kruppsee, Wolfssee and Großenbaumer See. Rahmer See isn't exempt. Historical 2018 ownership/club claim not independently proved for every shore segment; do not assert all banks publicly accessible or entirely private.
records.duplicates: No proven same-place duplicate; water sports and surrounding woods may have different access restrictions.
issues: No reliable positive contemporary cruising presence or peak.
Maintain explicit swimming ban in practical description.
Do not infer private association quote confirms exact boundaries.

records.name: Angermunder Baggerloch
records.identity: Gravel lakes Angermund, Heiderweg/Rodendeich, rather than one proven individual shore. Stored 51.318569,6.789478 locates broad lake complex. Düsseldorf's official named Angermunder Baggerseen both prohibit swimming. Municipal 2021 public access notes name two public entrances Zur Lindung and Holzbrücke An der Anger; those are official public entrances, NOT proved to be source's alleged gay shoreline.

activity.detail: Writer describes men at shore and disappointing wooded meetings, no verified sex encounter.

records.access: Designated legal footways and protected gravel-water landscape, no swimming, parts fenced/privately held, parking restrictions. Official city notes lack of legal car parks and ecological management.
records.duplicates: Separate named spots within Angermund reservoir system must not be automatically merged; source title broad and subarea unconfirmed.
issues: Important preserve municipal lake swimming prohibition, despite older source's summer swimming imagery.
Don't present 2021 named public entrances as verified sex-location instructions.
No independently supported active cruising time.

records.name: Hofgarten
records.identity: Old gay-szene source explicitly identifies Hofgarten paths along Inselstraße towards Ratinger Tor; saved 51.22932,6.77965 is general landscaped park point, not a verified secluded trail.

activity.detail: Commenter says they visited five times since arriving in November and had three encounters. This is a self-report, no independent verification.

records.access: Mixed-use public city garden; no present posted adult-use section and no independently checked specific night gate hours.
records.duplicates: Hofgarten and nearby historical station/civic restrooms are distinct contexts; park-wide pin does not locate original reported paths.
issues: Existing copy appropriately attributes user-reported December 2025 success, should not state regular guaranteed night crowd.
Old daytime/nightly peak from site description is unverified for Nov 2026.
Do not conflate park access with permission.

records.name: Parkplatz Efringen-Kirchen
records.identity: Original listing says car park off A5 exit Efringen-Kirchen near Kleinkems/Rheinaueweg at Rhine floodplain, not Lörrach city itself. Existing 47.67739,7.52194 is sourced broad parcel/map locator, not a verified 2026 lawful parking entrance. Suspected duplicate original index 775; same real site must be mapped in consolidation before duplicate merge.

activity.detail: Forum poster positively describes men meeting, but not a dated explicit sexual encounter.
Poster says site was fenced off and couldn't park, before cutoff but unresolved legal access.

records.access: 2025 request for site closure by local council was a proposal, not confirmed permanence. Fence and possibly protected floodplain make current parking access questionable; do not send users through fence or use private camping area as stand-in.
records.duplicates: Near-identical named candidate index 775 appears to refer to same location; preservation of provenance while deduplication still requires source pin comparison.
issues: MATERIAL access uncertainty: June 2026 positive visitor report does not prove old vehicle entrance reopened.
Do not state full closure from July 2025 fence claim alone.
Original text's 'Lörrach - Kleinkems' address label conflates municipality (Kleinkems is Efringen-Kirchen).

Düsseldorf Angermund gravel pit lakes swimming ban despite historical claims of nude swims
